music.stylePrompt: A refined 40-second instrumental underscore for a modern tenant communication product walkthrough. 96 BPM, 4/4, sixteen bars. Warm muted synth plucks, soft rounded bass, delicate tight electronic percussion, airy sustained chords. Clear, calm, confident, quietly optimistic. Sparse arrangement with room for spoken narration. Gentle two-second opening, steady understated pulse, a small lift in the final eight seconds, resolved final chord and short natural tail. Instrumental only. No vocals, no vocal chops, no spoken words, no dramatic drop, no loud lead melody.
